messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - us-east-1a inference path: elevated DNS latency + target health churn. 95th latency spiking from 120ms -> 1.2s, 5xxs up ~8%. Auto-alerting on-call.

alice_k: acked. on-call. paging in. starting triage. can someone paste the high-level graph?

bob_sre: looking. seeing a sawtooth pattern on resolver latency and a matching bump in NLB unhealthy counts for us-east-1a target group. Not seeing full AZ down, but ~30-45% of targets flapping.

carol_rt: confirmed kv-cache tail latency correlates with dns timeouts — K/V fetches time out while waiting on remote shards over same AZ. could be network jitter.

dave_ops: starting quick checks: ELB health + instance status.

bob_sre: running checks now:
```bash
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456:targetgroup/ri-inference-1/abcd \
  --query 'TargetHealthDescriptions[*].{Id:Target.Id,State:TargetHealth.State,Reason:TargetHealth.Reason}' --output table
```
output snip:
```
Id        State     Reason
i-0aa111 Healthy   N/A
i-0bb222 Unhealthy ELB timeout
i-0cc333 Unhealthy Failed health checks
... (~35% Unhealthy)
```

bob_sre: also checked instance status: `aws ec2 describe-instance-status --instance-ids ...` some instances show `network-unreachable` events in the last 5m.

alice_k: sounds like single-AZ network jitter causing partial target churn. immediate mitigation options: 1) steer traffic off us-east-1a to us-east-1b, 2) lower DNS TTL to accelerate client cutover, 3) enable fallback model variant in other AZs. prefer option (1)+(2) quick.

dave_ops: agree. preparing Route53 change to lower TTL to 30s for region entry record. will also adjust weighted routing to shift 60% -> us-east-1b.

carol_rt: can we also change inference runtime fallback policy to use local cache and smaller KV lookups for a minute to reduce cross-AZ fetches? I can push rollout to reduce flaky calls.

bob_sre: implementing traffic shift. applying weighted routing change.
```json
{
  "Comment": "lower TTL to accelerate failover and shift weight away from us-east-1a",
  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "UPSERT",
      "ResourceRecordSet": {
        "Name": "inference.rw.dev",
        "Type": "A",
        "SetIdentifier": "us-east-1a",
        "Weight": 40,
        "TTL": 30,
        "ResourceRecords": [{"Value": "52.1.2.3"}]
      }
    },
    {
      "Action": "UPSERT",
      "ResourceRecordSet": {
        "Name": "inference.rw.dev",
        "Type": "A",
        "SetIdentifier": "us-east-1b",
        "Weight": 60,
        "TTL": 30,
        "ResourceRecords": [{"Value": "52.9.9.9"}]
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

dave_ops: `aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z123 --change-batch file://shift-weight.json` -> submitted (chg id C123456).

alice_k: switching on-call to mitigation state. notifying customers via #customer-impact. @emma_cs can you gather affected customers (top 10 by qps) and start outreach template?

emma_cs: on it. grabbing list now. early read: 12 customers with >5% error rate, 3 with >15% error spikes. drafting note: "We're seeing elevated errors in us-east-1a, we've shifted traffic and are monitoring. No data loss. ETA next update in 15m."

grace_pm: +1 on comms. include suggested workaround: set API region=any (so SDKs will prefer region fallback).

bob_sre: after weight shift, observed NLB unhealthy percent drop to ~18% in us-east-1a and latency 95th moving down to 300-400ms. 5xx trend falling. still some residual error for sticky sessions due to DNS TTL and client side caching.

carol_rt: I've toggled runtime fallback to reduced KV radius; kvcache misses up but tail latency improved. pushing a short-lived canary to 10% of traffic for 5m then widen.

alice_k: good. monitoring. if errors keep falling, we'll keep traffic split 60/40 for 30m then gradually move back and re-evaluate.

bob_sre: also opened AWS support ticket with SR-987654: reported inconsistent instance network connectivity (ENI flaps) in us-east-1a affecting our inference fleet. cloud team is investigating.

dave_ops: quick note on techniques we used: lowered TTL -> weighted routing -> runtime fallback -> cache radius reduction. saved ~40% of immediate 5xx surface.

emma_cs: customer comms sent to affected list. responses: two customers reported transient failures but resumed after reroute. one enterprise asked for incident timeline. I'm prepping a follow-up with root cause when we have it.

alice_k: handoff plan: I'll be primary for the next 20m to validate stability. @bob_sre will take next-oncall at t+30m for postmortem and provider escalations. please add notes to the incident doc.

bob_sre: adding quick runbook entry for similar events: check resolver latency, ELB target churn, reduce kvcache radius, and consider immediate route53 weight changes. saving to /ops/incidents/runnerbook.md

carol_rt: note for postmortem: correlate kernel ENI resets (dmesg) with application timeouts, and evaluate whether our kvcache cross-AZ fetches should have a faster local degrade path.

dave_ops: observed provider-side metric: elevated host link errors reported in provider telemetry at 03:12Z. attaching SR reference https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/home?region=us-east-1#/case/?caseId=sr-987654 (internal link).

alice_k: current state: health improving, 95th latency back to ~180ms, 5xxs trending to baseline. keeping incident open for 45m observation window. preparing post-incident comms.

emma_cs: update sent to customers: initial triage + mitigation + "we are monitoring, will follow up with RCA".

grace_pm: thanks team. capture any pre-existing config that made us sensitive (long DNS TTLs, sticky session reliance) for RCA.

bob_sre: logged follow-up actions: (1) add faster local degrade path for KV fetches, (2) revisit DNS TTL defaults for region endpoints to <=60s, (3) add health-based automated traffic shift playbook, (4) escalate ENI flaps with provider if SR closes without fix.

alice_k: handing off: going to rest. @bob_sre you're on for the postmortem and customer RCA. closing pager but leaving thread open for notes. :thumbsup: (reaction)

incident-bot: incident updated: status=mitigated, severity=P1 -> P2, duration=~37m.

bob_sre: received handoff. will assemble timeline and assign RCA owners. closing thread when doc is ready.

emma_cs: closing comms plan drafted and ready for review.

carol_rt: small follow-up: deploy config to reduce cross-AZ KV fetch radius pushed at +12m, verify no regressions.

alice_k: thanks everyone. good coordination.
